title: Aunt Bev Hasn't LAUGHED in 492 Days 😂
description:
In this town, everyone has a number over their head, and everyone knows it counts the days since you last laughed. Past five hundred, your color starts to go.

My aunt Bev is the funniest person in our family. She laughs all night on league night. Her number says 492.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
